title: FieldFlow Mobile Companion App
summary: A fast, thumb-friendly mobile application for tracking project milestones, field updates, and executive metrics on Android and iOS.
challenge: Teams working on site or on the move need immediate access to project status and analytics without wrestling with desktop tables.
solution: Designed a crisp dark-mode mobile experience featuring streamlined navigation, milestone checklists, and instant team activity views.
